findings: QM5_12940 source lines 281 and 293 reset the directional cooldown inside Strategy_EntrySignal before QM_TM_OpenPosition runs at line 514, so an order rejection consumes the signal and suppresses the next eligible entry for the configured cooldown.

QM5_12940 source lines 354-359 and 385-390 set g_trade_state.t1_hit=true even when normalized half-volume is invalid or the bool-returning QM_TM_PartialClose call fails; the required 50% T1 close can therefore be skipped while post-T1 trailing is activated.

QM5_12940 OnInit zeroes g_trade_state at line 441, while open-position reconstruction at lines 312-320 forces t1_hit=false and derives T1 from the current signal globals rather than durable original-entry state; a restart cannot deterministically resume the card's partial-close and post-T1 trail state.

Build artifact artifacts/qm5_12940_build_result.json marks smoke_result as deferred_p2_smoke with blocked_reason=null; this lacks the tester-saturation evidence required by the deferred-smoke waiver, and no QM5_12940 smoke summary exists under D:/QM/reports/smoke.
